title: Ha'il — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ha'il: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ha’il has a population of 450,000. The capital of the Ha’il Region in northern Saudi Arabia, known for its mountainous landscape and cultural festivals. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 315 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
